COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
02.06.2026 SPA No.188 of 2026 
Anjali Bhandari --Appellant 
Versus
Graphic Era Hill University and Another --Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Neeraj Kumar Garg (through V.C.) and 
Mr. Ayush Pokhriyal, learned counsel for the
appellant.
2. Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, learned counsel for
respondent no.2.
3. Order of the Hon’ble Supreme Court dated 
26.05.2026 in W.P.(C) No(s).31 & 32 of 2025 and 
SLP (Crl.) No.9450/2026 (II-D) filed against the 
judgment of Delhi High Court has been placed 
before us.
4. The representation filed by the appellant in 
pursuance of liberty granted by the learned Single 
Judge has been rejected by the Standing 
Committee of Legal Education Committee of the 
Bar Council of India by order dated 26.05.2026. 
The said order has also been placed before us and 
the copy of the same has also admittedly been 
received by the appellant.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant states that 
he does not wish to challenge the order passed by 
the Standing Committee of Legal Education 
Committee of the Bar Council of India dated 
26.05.2026. 6. Be that as it may. Since the examinations in 
which the appellant wanted to appear are already 
over, we consider it appropriate to grant time to 
the respondents to file counter affidavit.
7. List the matter after two weeks.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
